B (direct extern reads at point of use, no locals) real 435 / 454 / 9t / fuzzy 90.2180 -- MWCC will not hoist a bare extern global read across the loop's calls, so every use reloads. C (named externs bound to block-top locals declared BEFORE the zeroing loop) real 452, hoist lands too early, reverted. D (place_cam given an `f32 lat` fifth PARAMETER, `lat` passed at the in-block site and lbl_80345EC8 at the other five) real 458 -- NEGATIVE, cause identified: making it a parameter forces the constant into call-argument evaluation position at all five outside sites and reorders their lfs/stfs pairs (new clusters appeared at 0x268 and 0x3ac that were previously clean). F = C' plus manual inline of place_cam at the ONE in-block site only: real 438 / 453 / 8t / fuzzy 92.4742, `bl _savefpr_27` now byte-identical to target (was _savefpr_28), frame 240->216, and ALL FIVE callee-saved FPRs land on the target's exact assignments f31=lbl_80345EC8, f30=lbl_80345F58, f29=lbl_80345F68, f28=lbl_80345F60, f27=lbl_80346180. KEPT F.

NEGATIVE AXES, all reverted, all A/B/A confirmed: (i) gCameraTargets-as-blob-displacement. Target materializes the tracked-target array as `addi rD,r31,2576` off the live gCameraState base (gCameraTargets 0x80240218 - gCameraState 0x8023F808 = 0xA10 = 2576, arithmetic verified in config/GUNE5D/symbols.txt). Probed form: in cam_blocked, `CameraTarget* t = (CameraTarget*)((u8*)gCameraState + 0xA10);` replacing `CameraTarget* t = gCameraTargets;`. Measured TWICE, on two different bases: on C' it gave real 587 / insns 452 / multiset 7t / fuzzy 91.3056, and RE-A/B'd on the improved F base per the alignment-sensitivity rule it gave insns 452 / real 585 / fuzzy 91.9551. Both NEGATIVE. Cause identified and it is not the spelling: the edit DOES delete the lis at both loop sites (confirmed in the aligned view), but MWCC then hoists the blob address out of the loop into one live register, whereas the target REMATERIALISES `addi rD,r31,2576` at each cam_blocked inline site. The surplus moves from lis to addi rather than disappearing. (ii) `s32 mode = lbl_80344538;` moved into the same inner block to match the target's post-loop `lwz r26` placement: the @0x60 cluster genuinely CLOSES (confirmed in --ops) and real improves 438->436, but fuzzy regresses 92.4742->92.4404 because the still-present gCameraTargets lis slides into a worse alignment slot. Reverted -- structural progress that cannot be cashed until axis (i) is served. (iii) The camBase/cam self-update axis was NOT retried: attempt.get-cam-wpos-camera-base-rescreen.20260830.v2 records both candidate forms (camBase+0xC8+offsetof, and the self-referential cam) as BYTE-IDENTICAL across two sessions, which is a compiler-normalisation fact rather than an alignment fact, so the discipline-10 re-A/B licence does not reach it.
